steps.content: [Corridor]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This must be the place.

Guided by your shackles, you arrive at a corridor that seems to stretch endlessly into the dark. The hallway is empty, its floorboards creaking slightly from years of neglect. The candle holders on the walls have long been extinguished, their rusted surfaces streaked with hardened wax that drips in eerie, twisted patterns.

Tightly shut doors line both sides of the corridor, each one like a gateway to another unknown world. The cold and darkness press in around you. You can sense that the shadow clinging to Graves is nearby.
[White flash] [Horror sound effect]

Suddenly, a faint yet eerie sound breaks the silence. It's quiet but piercing, like nails scraping against jagged stone, accompanied by rubbing and murmurs that seem to shift and fade. The noise feels far away yet somehow near, as if it's creeping up right behind you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Who are you?

There's no response. Your words vanish into the empty air like stones cast into a bottomless sea, quickly devoured by the silence. The only sound in this desolate corridor is the echo of your footsteps against the floor.
[White flash] [Sound effect] [Shadow jumps out] [Shadow slowly fades away]

A sudden rush of air brushes past your back, as if something darted by. It happened too quickly for you to catch on. You spin around, your eyes scanning the dimly lit corridor—but there's nothing there.

Only the stained glass windows stand silently on the walls, their once-vivid patterns now faded and peeling. Thorns have forced their way in from outside, violently piercing the glass and leaving a jagged hole. Through the gaps, an icy wind howls softly, rushing down the corridor with a faint yet grating whine—like someone snickering in the shadows.
You stare into the empty corridor, confirming there's nothing behind you, and breathe a sigh of relief. Just as you're about to keep walking—
Are you truly ready?
Was that a vow, or merely a lie...
The somber question echoes against the stone walls. A massive shadow stretches across the floor in the moonlight, but when your eyes trace back to its source, you find nothing there.

Do you accept her festering heart? Will you kiss the blue mold blooming from her spine? Do you promise to never wipe away the bloodstains on the wedding ring? Do you swear to love her shattered skull more than any intact soul?
The resonant voice echoes all around you, its probing questions closing in, yet the speaker refuses to reveal themselves.
Vows? Promises? Laughable. Childish ceremonies can't shield you from impending deaths, nor prevent the inevitable separation.
I once made the same vow: "I'll stay with you forever." But then the war came and took everything. In the end, all she got was a cold, silent tombstone.

The shadow vanishes abruptly. You look around, as the painted eyes from the ancient oil portraits on the walls stare at you. You can't identify who was questioning you, but whoever it is clearly harbors intense hostility toward you and your upcoming wedding.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't have such a profound understanding of marriage, nor your kind of experience. If possible, would you be willing to reveal yourself and share your wisdom? I'd very much like to hear your perspective.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You seem to care so much about this wedding, yet you hide in the shadows intimidating the couple with your negativity... Is this what you call "maturity" and "caution"?
Your tone may be gentle, but the shackles on your wrists haven't loosened one bit. The voice isn't provoked by your words—it only responds with a cold, mocking laugh.
A toast to your courage, a toast to your foolishness, a toast to your... arrogance in knowing nothing of separation.
This feels different from the obsession that grips Graves. The shackles don't react to the voice—this isn't the "shadow" you're searching for.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thank you for your "blessing," but I have more important matters to attend to ensure our wedding proceeds smoothly.
An unintentional trap is a hundred times crueler than any calculated harm! You shouldn't give her false hope!
Now, say your vows—will you take her hand, knowing you'll weave her wedding dress from lies?
From the depths of the corridor, a dark figure emerges once more, its long sword scraping against the floor with an agonizing screech as it moves toward you. This is anything but friendly!
Acting on instinct, you open a small door in the hallway and squeeze inside.
[Black Screen]
Foolish young one, do you honestly think this is a celebration?
Or perhaps... your promises are nothing but empty lies that won't last even a moment? You'll leave her to face everything alone, abandoned once again!
The accusing voice doesn't fade away—instead, it grows sharper, each sentence seemingly tearing through the air and slipping through the door crack.

You press your body against the cold stone door, holding your breath. The room is pitch black, the sound of your heartbeat breaking the silence. It draws closer—footsteps echo faintly, like something prowling in the darkness, its presence cold and suffocating as it approaches.
You instinctively tighten your grip, power pulsing in your palm as you waver, hesitating whether to rush out and confront whatever's out there. Suddenly, you hear a soft sound—
The candles inside the room light up.
At the same time, the red spike pulses in your palm. You sense that the shadow you've been searching for is now just within reach.
[Study]
